entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Yes, I hope so. I ordered something and I'm just... I'm very confused about what to do next. It's all a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help clear things up for you. To start, could I get your name and the order number?
Yes, the name is David Miller, and the order number is... VF789012.

Thank you, David. I have your order right here for the Aero Race Jersey. I see you received it about a week ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the jersey?

A preference? I suppose so. I'm not sure. The website's sizing chart was a little hard to follow, and the jersey I received is the wrong size. It's just way too tight across the shoulders. I can't really move in it. Can't you just help me?

I absolutely can help with that, David. It sounds like you just need a straightforward exchange for a larger size, and that's no problem at all. Since you received it only seven days ago, you're well within our 90-day return policy for apparel.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with it. So, you can just... fix it for me?

Yes, we can. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us, so I want to make this as smooth as possible for you. I'm going to process the exchange right now. I'll email you a prepaid return label for the jersey that's too tight. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'll also upgrade the shipping on your replacement to our 2-day express service, free of charge.
Wow, really? That's so helpful. That takes all the stress out of it. Thank you so much.
You're very welcome. So, what size would you like for the new jersey?
A Large, please. I think that should be perfect.

Excellent. I have initiated the exchange for a size Large. The return label is on its way to your email now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. We'll get the new one sent out right away. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help, Sarah. Thank you.
It was my pleasure, David. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
